next_step_summary: PR #254 implements the fourth accepted post-audit correction by adding a minimal structured finding-resolution contract. A FindingCandidate is now separate from its second-pass FindingResolution; the only resolution outcomes are CONFIRMED, NARROWED, and CLEARED; and the resolution records the related local/sanitized references reviewed plus an internal resolution summary. This prevents a merely detected concerning phrase from being treated as a final finding before cross-clause review. The change remains provider-independent and does not add a universal relation graph, statutory runtime, ranking/UI, OCR, or provider integration. The next bounded step builds a smart-analysis corpus focused on semantic counterexamples and cross-clause cases rather than generic lease summarization.
